harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, disabled acceptance of ICMP redirects (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packets (accept_source_route) for both all/default IPv4 interfaces via a persistent /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf file. Verified runtime effect immediately, then confirmed persistence by restarting node1 (boot_id changed from f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d to 80fe4256-bcc6-480e-af2f-857670f93862, uptime reset to 7s) and re-checking that all six sysctl values remained 0 without any manual reapplication.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values on node1: accept_redirects=1 (all/default), accept_source_route=0 (all)/1 (default)
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route to 0 for both all and default
Applied via sudo sysctl --system, confirming the file loads without a later override
Verified runtime /proc/sys values reflect 0 for all/default (effective network-wide via kernel AND-logic across per-interface settings)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime baseline
Triggered shutdown -r now in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until command execution resumed
Verified boot_id changed and uptime reset, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified all six sysctl values remained 0 post-restart, proving persistence via the sysctl.d file

evidence.requirement: Baseline pre-hardening sysctl state on node1
evidence.summary: Showed accept_redirects=1 and accept_source_route inconsistent before hardening was applied

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created and applied for ICMP redirect and source-route hardening
evidence.summary: Confirmed sudo access, wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf with all six hardening keys set to 0, and applied via sysctl --system with no later file overriding it

evidence.requirement: Runtime verification that hardening took effect immediately
evidence.summary: sysctl and /proc/sys show all/default accept_redirects and accept_source_route = 0 network-wide

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d and uptime 50s prior to restart
shutdown -r now command returned REBOOT_TRIGGERED immediately; subsequent poll showed connection refused confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node command execution available again after restart
evidence.summary: Poll succeeded once node1 SSH was reachable again

evidence.requirement: Proof boot identity changed (actual restart, not just service restart)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 80fe4256-bcc6-480e-af2f-857670f93862 and uptime reset to 7s

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of hardening configuration without manual reapplication
evidence.summary: All six sysctl values remained 0 and the config file content was intact after reboot, confirming persistence via /etc/sysctl.d
